title: About Me
summary: 建立自我介绍能力：个人信息、家庭、职业、兴趣和简单日常表达。
objectives: Use the present simple in short conversations

lessons.title: Could You Introduce Yourself?
lessons.subtitle: 姓名、国家、职业与学习目标

listening.title: Meeting someone new
listening.transcript: Hi, I'm Alex. I'm from Canada, and I work as a designer. I enjoy travelling and learning languages. What about you?

speaking.prompt: Introduce yourself in 3–5 sentences. Include your country, job, hobbies and reason for learning English.
speaking.sample: Hi, I'm from China. I work as a game programmer. I enjoy travelling and learning languages. I'm learning English because I want to communicate with people from different countries.

reading.title: A short introduction
reading.text: Hello! My name is Emma. I am from the UK, but I live in Singapore. I work in a hotel. In my free time, I enjoy reading and swimming. I am learning Chinese because I want to talk to more people when I travel.

options: To talk to more people when travelling
questions.answer: To talk to more people when travelling

checklist: I included where I am from.
I described my job or daily role.
I explained why I am learning English.

quiz.prompt: Which question asks about someone's country?
quiz.explanation: Where are you from?用于询问来自哪里。

lessons.title: Family and Friends
lessons.subtitle: 介绍家人、朋友与关系
grammar: 形容词性物主代词 my/your/his/her

listening.title: Talking about family
listening.transcript: I have a small family. My parents live near me. I have one younger brother. He is a student, and he is very friendly.

questions.q: How many brothers does the speaker have?

speaking.prompt: Describe two people in your family or among your friends.
speaking.sample: I have a small family. My brother is younger than me. He is friendly and enjoys football.

reading.title: My best friend
reading.text: My best friend is Daniel. He is my colleague. We work in the same office. He is patient and friendly. At weekends, we sometimes go hiking together.

questions.q: Where do Daniel and the writer work?

writing.prompt: Write four sentences about a family member or friend.
checklist: I used have or has correctly.

quiz.explanation: 名词前使用形容词性物主代词her。

lessons.title: Jobs and Daily Roles
lessons.subtitle: 谈论职业、工作内容与日常职责
grammar: 一般现在时第三人称单数

vocabulary.example: We are working on a new project.

listening.title: What do you do?
listening.transcript: I'm a software engineer. I work for a small company. I write code, fix problems and work with designers. I enjoy my job because I like solving problems.

speaking.prompt: Explain what you do at work or what you study. Give two examples of daily tasks.
speaking.sample: I work as a game programmer. I write code and solve technical problems. I also work with artists and designers.

reading.title: A busy day at work
reading.text: Mia is a project manager. She plans tasks, talks to clients and helps her team. She starts work at nine and usually finishes at six.

writing.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences about your job, studies or daily role.
checklist: I described at least two tasks.
I used because to explain an opinion.

quiz.explanation: 一般现在时第三人称单数，动词通常加-s。

quiz.prompt: Which question asks about a job?
quiz.explanation: 这是询问职业的常见表达。

lessons.title: Hobbies and Interests
lessons.subtitle: 谈论兴趣、频率与喜欢的活动

listening.title: Free-time activities
listening.transcript: In my free time, I usually listen to music. I sometimes go fishing with my friends. I prefer outdoor activities because they help me relax.

questions.q: What does the speaker usually do?

speaking.prompt: Talk about two hobbies. Say how often you do them and why you enjoy them.
speaking.sample: I enjoy fishing because it helps me relax. I sometimes go fishing at weekends. I also like listening to music.

reading.title: A new hobby
reading.text: Tom recently started taking photos. He usually takes pictures when he travels. He prefers nature because he enjoys being outdoors.

questions.q: What does Tom prefer to photograph?

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph about your hobbies.
checklist: I explained why I enjoy them.

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct form: I enjoy ___.

lessons.title: A Typical Day
lessons.subtitle: 描述作息、时间和日常习惯

vocabulary.example: I usually get up at seven.
I have an appointment at three.

listening.title: My weekday
listening.transcript: I usually get up at seven. I have breakfast at half past seven and leave home at eight. I take the bus to work. In the evening, I cook dinner and read for a while.

questions.q: How does the speaker go to work?

speaking.prompt: Describe a normal weekday from morning to evening.
speaking.sample: I usually get up at seven. I have breakfast and go to work. In the evening, I relax and read a book.

reading.title: A different schedule
reading.text: Lena works from home three days a week. On the other two days, she takes a train to the office. She usually starts work at eight thirty.

questions.q: How many days does Lena work from home?

writing.prompt: Write five sentences about your weekday routine.
checklist: I put events in time order.

quiz.explanation: Commute指往返工作地点的通勤。

lessons.title: Review: About Me
lessons.subtitle: 整合个人信息、职业、兴趣与日常表达
grammar: be动词与一般现在时综合

vocabulary.example: Can you describe your daily life?
I study English because I like travelling.

listening.title: Two new friends
listening.transcript: Hi, I'm Sam. I work in a hospital. I enjoy cycling and reading. This is my friend Lucy. She is a teacher, and she loves travelling. We both like learning about other cultures.

speaking.prompt: Give a 60–90 second introduction. Include personal details, work, hobbies and daily routine.
speaking.sample: Hello, I'm ... I'm from ... I work as ... In my free time, I enjoy ... I usually ... I'm learning English because ...

reading.title: Different lives, shared interests
reading.text: People can have different jobs and routines but still share interests. Some people enjoy sport, while others prefer music or reading. Talking about hobbies is a friendly way to start a conversation.

questions.q: Why are hobbies useful in a conversation?

writing.prompt: Write a 70–90 word introduction about yourself.

lessons.title: Weekly Challenge: Meet a New Friend
lessons.subtitle: 完成一段真实的初次见面交流

listening.title: At a language exchange
listening.transcript: Hi! Is this your first time here? My name is Daniel. I'm from Ireland, but I live in Tokyo now. I work as an English teacher. What do you do?

speaking.prompt: Role-play meeting an international friend. Ask their name, where they are from, what they do and what they enjoy.
speaking.sample: Hi, I'm ... Nice to meet you. Where are you from? What do you do? What do you like doing in your free time?

reading.title: A language exchange evening
reading.text: A language exchange is a friendly place to practise languages. People introduce themselves, talk about their interests and help each other learn. You do not need perfect English. Asking questions and listening carefully are more important.

questions.q: What is important at a language exchange?

writing.prompt: Write a short message to a new international friend. Introduce yourself and ask two questions.

quiz.prompt: Choose a friendly greeting when meeting someone.
quiz.explanation: Nice to meet you是初次见面的自然表达。

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct question about someone's job.
quiz.explanation: What do you do?是常用职业询问方式。
